correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the credited exact finite distribution with rational exhaustive enumeration through n=5; verified its symmetry and normalization. value.rationale: The original authors isolate qualitatively different 1/n and 1/sqrt(n) regimes, leaving the natural transition unquantified. The exact n^{-1/2} window with nontrivial square-root crossover resolves how the limits connect, while the two endpoint atoms and signed bulk establish a mechanism and identify where finite total-variation mass comes from. This is a motivated sharp asymptotic theorem, not merely a parameter renaming.
